training_dataset: Supplied ConvectNow checkpoint; its scripts claim a SEVIR-derived split, not independently reproduced
input_contract: Float tensor shaped [batch, 4, time, height, width]; channels are VIL/reflectivity, temporal delta, IR cooling, and lightning
output_contract: Experimental spatial nowcast plus uncalibrated hail, cloudburst, downburst, and convective-initiation heads
limitations: The state dictionary contains no run metadata, dataset manifest, split IDs, normalization statistics, or calibration record.
The supplied evaluation report cannot be tied cryptographically to this checkpoint or independently reproduced from retained artifacts.
The four input channels are not yet available as a co-registered, issue-time-safe VAJRA replay cube.
Hazard head outputs must not be displayed as probabilities, alerts, ETA, or operational guidance.
The model is registered for engineering smoke tests only until frozen-set evaluation is completed.
